subject: Pilot onboarding request: VertexScale integration — PO waiver for 30-day pilot
messages:

Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot onboarding request — VertexScale/Redwood integration (no-PO?)

Hi Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — super excited about the integration possibilities. We have a short, non-production pilot we'd like to run next week (30 days, limited scope) to validate throughput and the latency profile with Redwood.

Ask: can VertexScale be onboarded into Redwood's platform for this 30-day pilot without a formal PO up front? We are a small startup and typically operate on net-30 invoices for trials. For the pilot we expect <$5,000 in usage.

We have attached:
- VertexScale_SOC2_Type2_snapshot.pdf (current certification)
- pilot-sow.docx (high-level scope)

If needed we can accept an onboarding form and sign a short SOW now; we'd prefer to avoid a long procurement loop so engineering can start next week.

Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Elaine Park

elaine@vertexscale.io
+1 415-555-0122

Subject: Fwd: Pilot onboarding request — VertexScale/Redwood integration (no-PO?)

Ben / Monica — forwarding request from VertexScale. TL;DR: they want a 30-day pilot, expected spend <$5k, asking if we can onboard without a PO to get engineering started next week. They provided SOC2 and a short SOW.

What I need:
- Quick procurement sign-off (exception or standard PO?)
- Any legal/T&Cs flag we should block on?

I attached our vendor onboarding form to capture banking/W9 info if we grant an exception. If we can do a conditional exception (limited dollar cap, limited duration, vendor must complete onboarding paperwork and submit invoice within 30 days) that would be ideal.

Thanks — happy to take a 10-min call.

Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding request — VertexScale/Redwood integration (no-PO?)

Thanks for the context, Jordan. A few procurement points:

- PO policy: default is we require a PO for any vendor spend. Exceptions are allowed but must be time-limited, dollar-capped, and documented on the vendor record.
- Risk: we need to confirm SOC2 is current (looks OK from the snapshot) and capture a supplier risk score.
- Legal/T&C: if the SOW has non-standard indemnities or data commitments, legal should review prior to signing.

I can provisionally approve a PO-waiver for a 30-day pilot up to $5,000 if VertexScale:
  1) Completes the vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (W9, remittance info),
  2) Signs the SOW (DocuSign link preferred), and
  3) Submits invoices within 30 days of pilot end.

Attached is a quick supplier-risk-assessment.xlsx — please ask VertexScale to fill the relevant fields and return. If legal flags anything unusual, we'll rescind.

Ben Carter
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: supplier-risk-assessment.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 15:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding request — VertexScale/Redwood integration (no-PO?)

Jordan / Ben — I dug in on a quick review. Approving the exception with the following hard conditions:

- Pilot window: up to 45 days (30 days preferred)
- Dollar cap: $7,500 total spend during pilot
- Required docs before access granted to production-like systems: signed SOW (DocuSign), completed vendor onboarding form (W9 + remittance), and supplier-risk-assessment returned
- Invoice routing: Vendor must invoice to procurements@redwood.com (Net 30). Failure to invoice within 60 days means we will not pay (escalation to legal).

Please confirm Jordan that VertexScale will complete the forms and route the signed SOW link back to me. Once I have those artifacts I will mark the vendor record as "Pilot Approved - PO Waiver" and notify Finance.

Monica Patel
Head of Strategic Procurement | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
